description: This file defines the GLClosure entity class, representing a general ledger closure record within the accounting module of the Fineract project. It includes properties such as office, closing date, comments, and deletion status, along with methods for creation from JSON input and updating properties.

classes.name: GLClosure
classes.description: Entity class representing a general ledger closure, with properties for office, closing date, comments, and deletion status, including methods for instantiation from JSON and updating properties.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a GLClosure instance from JSON input, extracting closing date and comments.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the comments property if changed, returning a map of actual changes.

methods.name: handlePropertyUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating a specific property if a change is detected in the JSON command.
